summary.text: Bill Allen is a Republican member of the Missouri House of Representatives who has represented District 17 since January 2023 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Democrat Susan Hoisington is also on the general election ballot.

paragraphs.text: Bill Allen was born in Kansas City, Kansas, and served in the U.S. Navy from 1984 to 2008.
He earned a bachelor's degree from Embry-Riddle Aeronautical University in 1993, a graduate degree from Troy University in 2003 and a Ph.D. from Capella University in 2013.
His career experience includes working as a higher education administrator, and he has been affiliated with Rotary and St. James Catholic Church.
Allen was assigned to the House Insurance, Pensions, and Professional Registration and Licensing committees for 2025-2026.
